deviation_mechanism: Quarter-wave optical thickness (QWOT) initialization at 375 nm imposes a strict harmonic ratio between adjacent layers (lambda/2 and lambda/4). In a dual-band reflection architecture, this rigid scaling couples the optical path lengths of neighboring materials, preventing independent phase tuning required to open stopbands at two distinct wavelengths. The optimizer becomes trapped in a local minimum where it cannot break the QWOT proportionality to satisfy both spectral windows, yielding a flattened objective landscape.
